title: Site as data: the site store and the tenant context
description:
Why: a tenant has no repository. Core reads site configuration, brand pack, pages and nav through one SiteStore and carries identity through one TenantContext. The repository becomes a seed, so the dedicated tier cannot drift into a second code path. Text lives in S3; DynamoDB holds only the catalogue.
Done when: output from a file-seeded store and from the database-backed store is byte identical. Ends with a p.apyr.us page.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Workstream (f) tasks: PPY-1252ce (SiteConfig schema and the v1 surface; lists what customers cannot set), PPY-e572de (brand pack storage, allowed fonts, per-tenant brand stylesheet), PPY-413576 (render from the store; hooks refused on the shared stack), PPY-91fb68 (live preview), PPY-b21340 (home templates), PPY-272c84 (MoM-shaped fixture; MoM stays dedicated). Catalogue rows are models PPY-c020ce. Retiring the 75% scaler stays in PPY-2a44b2.
